examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Baseline range picker with Start/End time fields and a timezone selector (defaults to the user local zone; set `timezone` to pin a specific IANA zone).
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CalendarRoot from '@aziontech/webkit/calendar-root'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const range = ref(null)
</script>

<template>
  <CalendarRoot
    v-model="range"
    mode="range"
    clearable
    show-time
    show-timezone
  />
</template>

Single
examples.summary: Single-date mode picks one day instead of a range.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CalendarRoot from '@aziontech/webkit/calendar-root'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const date = ref(null)
</script>

<template>
  <CalendarRoot
    v-model="date"
    mode="single"
    placeholder="Select date"
  />
</template>
